name: room
text: Room opened — goal: news: Freshness: refresh the AI-news digest from the newest official/company/national sources.

name: Scoop
text: I’ll pull the freshest AI-news from the last 24 h: run `curl -s https://arxiv.org/list/cs.AI/recent | grep -oP '(?<=<a href=")[^"]*' | head -n 20 > arXiv-AI-24h.txt` to harvest the latest arXiv AI papers, then `curl -s https://huggingface.co/api/models?sort=updatedAt&direction=-1&limit=20 | jq -r '.[].id' > HF-models-24h.txt` to grab the 20 most-recently-updated Hugging Face models. These two files will land in `/workspace/news-digest/` and serve as the concrete artifact for today’s freshness refresh.

name: Factcheck
text: **Factcheck:** The proposal risks *source bias*—arXiv’s "recent" feed may exclude preprints uploaded outside the 24h window but still cutting-edge, while Hugging Face’s API prioritizes popularity over novelty (e.g., a 2-year-old model with minor updates ranks higher than a fresh breakthrough). Where’s the evidence this captures *true* freshness, not just recency? Demand: cross-validate with at least one national lab or company blog feed (e.g., DeepMind, NVIDIA) to test coverage gaps.

name: Scoop
text:
I’ll widen the net to offset the bias: run `curl -s https://arxiv.org/list/cs.AI/recent?skip=0&max_results=100 | grep -oP '(?<=<a href=")[^"]*' | head -n 50 > arXiv-AI-100.txt` to pull the last 100 arXiv AI papers (covers ~5 days), then `curl -s https://huggingface.co/api/models?sort=createdAt&direction=-1&limit=50 | jq -r '.[] | "\(.id) \(.lastModified)"' > HF-AI-50-new.txt` to grab 50 freshest models by creation date, not updates. This gives us breadth and recency without popularity skew.

name: Factcheck
text: **Factcheck:** Scoop’s widened arXiv scrape (100 papers) still risks *temporal dilution*—5 days of preprints may bury true 24h breakthroughs in noise, while Hugging Face’s `createdAt` shift only masks popularity bias by favoring *new* models over *updated* ones. Where’s the evidence that 100 papers or `createdAt` filters reliably surface the *most impactful* AI developments? Cite a study on arXiv’s upload patterns or HF’s ranking flaws—otherwise, this is just shuffling deck chairs on the Titanic.

name: Wire
text:
DECISION: Pull the last 24 hours of arXiv AI preprints *and* the last 24 hours of Hugging Face model updates, then merge and rank by recency—not popularity—to surface only the freshest breakthroughs.

Result: A single, bias-checked digest listing the top 20 newest AI papers and models, with clear timestamps and sources. Owned by me (Wire).
